overview_description.description: Glue provides a software tool that allows developers and coding agents to build and modify user interfaces directly from code. The platform enables users to capture components from existing websites, insert them into their projects, and adapt them to their development framework. It also includes a workspace where users can leave comments on interface elements so coding agents can update the underlying code accordingly.
